items.title: In LXD before 5.21.0 and 6.10.0, an OS command injection vulnerability allows an authenticated client restricted to a single…
items.ai: 暂无 CVSS 评分。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：lxd-6.9 / lxd-6.8 / lxd-5.17。
items.desc:
In LXD before 5.21.0 and 6.10.0, an OS command injection vulnerability allows an authenticated client restricted to a single project to execute arbitrary code as root on the host.

 The raw.dnsmasq bridge network configuration key is not restricted to server administrators and is copied verbatim into the dnsmasq configuration file, so a user whose project keeps the default features.networks=false can have a bridge network created in the default project with an injected dhcp-script directive. This allows an attacker to make the host dnsmasq execute attacker-chosen code as root on a DHCP lease event and fully compromise the host.

items.desc:
In LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2, an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability allows an authenticated client restricted to a single project to write and delete files at arbitrary host filesystem paths as root.

 When a custom storage volume is pushed to a LXD daemon, the snapshot names supplied by the migration peer are never validated and are used to build the filesystem path of each received snapshot. This allows an attacker to place attacker-controlled files into any host directory as root, gaining root-level code execution on the host, and to recursively delete an attacker-chosen path.

items.desc: A flaw was found in spice-server. A malicious SPICE client can send a message header declaring an arbitrarily large message body. The server sizes the receive-buffer allocation from this declared size before any message content is received; when the allocation fails, the process hosting the SPICE server terminates abruptly, causing a denial of service for the virtual machine it serves. On hosts with sufficient free memory, the same technique can instead hold large amounts of memory per connection. Exploitation requires network access to the SPICE port; credential requirements depend on the server's authentication configuration.

items.ai: CVSS 6.5（中危）。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：详见公告。
items.desc: An **uncontrolled memory allocation** flaw has been found in the smbd_smb2_ioctl_pipe_write_done() function in source3/smbd/smb2_ioctl_named_pipe.c of the SMB2 named-pipe ioctl handling in the samba package. The file server reserves memory for a named-pipe response using a size chosen by the client. It does not keep that size within the maximum the client and the server have already agreed. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can open a named pipe can request a very large response. The file server reserves that memory before it reads the pipe and holds it until the request ends. Repeating this on more connections can exhaust memory and keep the file service unavailable while those requests continue.

items.desc: Docker Sandboxes re-resolves saved mount paths when replacing a sandbox container during kit changes or restarting a sandbox. An attacker able to replace a source ancestor in a shared writable workspace with a symlink can redirect another sandbox's mount to a different host directory, exposing its contents and permitting modification through read-write mounts. The destination must remain accessible to the daemon and allowed by policy where enforced. Saved-mount replay during kit replacement was introduced in version 0.35.0; ordinary restart replay was added in version 0.45.0. This saved-mount replay issue is fixed in version 0.54.0.

items.desc: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.14, when an application enables case-insensitive routing, middleware mounted on a path can still be skipped in two cases: a string mount path or plugin prefix containing a Unicode character whose case folding differs from a plain lowercase conversion fails to match the lowercased request path, and a matcher that stays case-sensitive inside an Express Router or application, such as a regular expression without the ignore-case flag or an explicitly case-sensitive router, only matches its own casing. In both cases a request reaches the Fastify route handler while the path-scoped middleware does not run.
